meaning:
1) contend, have power, contend with, persist, exert oneself, persevere
1a) (Qal) to persevere, contend with

renderings.kjv: for as a prince hast thou power

elsewhere.note: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he contended with God.
